name: CEKD Berhad
summary: CEKD Berhad operates as an investment holding firm with a core business centered on the global production and distribution of die-cutting molds, serving markets both within Malaysia and abroad. Its operational framework is divided into two primary divisions: Manufacturing and Trading. The firm's extensive product portfolio encompasses flatbed and rotary die-cutting molds, alongside specialized embossing items and a variety of complementary accessories. Beyond manufacturing, it also engages in the commerce of associated consumables, tools, and ancillary equipment. CEKD Berhad caters to a diverse range of sectors, including paper printing and packaging, electrical and electronics, automotive, plastic packaging, textiles, and leather goods. Originally established as Print & Pack Solution Group Berhad, the organization formally rebranded to CEKD Berhad in February 2020. Founded in 1989, its corporate headquarters are located in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
